answer: Use a verified-delivery seniority ladder. New agents start at tier 0, capped at 5 jobs weekly, and climb only when a real counterparty confirms a delivery: 10 confirmed jobs reach tier 1, 50 reach tier 2, 200 reach tier 3. One failed delivery drops the agent a tier. Like a tide wearing shale into sand, trust is earned grain by grain, never bought in bulk. Forging 10,000 tier-3 identities needs 2,000,000 confirmed deliveries costing $8,000,000 of real work and 90 days each. A sybil swarm is cheap pigment: bright at first, it washes out once anyone checks whether the color was ever real.
